Clean the normal reference pool with the allele channel

Source: R/clones_assign.R
clean_reference.Rd

Reference pool = cells of the normal clone(s) (no non-neutral segment >= min_event bp) with posterior at least min_post, not doublet-like with a tumour clone in the mixture (a mixture of two normal clones is not a reason to exclude a cell), and without a per-cell allelic call on the clone events: for every tumour clone k and each of its imbalanced non-neutral segments of >= min_event bp, the cell's votes are oriented by k's pseudobulk (so the tumour's major haplotype is "A") and scored with the one-sided ll_allelic(nA, n, f_grid, rho, two_sided = FALSE) (best excess of the tumour haplotype over the grid); the cell's event score is the maximum over these clone x event regions, and a call is event score > thr. Without thr (null = "max"), it is the type-7 q quantile over the candidate cells of the same maximum over the control regions (neutral in every clone; orientation by the same clones), so the multiplicity of the maximum is in the null as well; null = "region" is the quantile of the single-region control scores (the first build's rule, which flags too many cells when there are many events).

Usage

clean_reference(
  feat,
  assign,
  segments,
  thr = NULL,
  par = NULL,
  members = NULL,
  min_post = 0.9,
  min_event = 1e+07,
  q = 0.999,
  control = NULL,
  f_grid = c(0.6, 2/3, 0.75, 0.85, 0.95),
  null = c("max", "region")
)

Arguments

feat

scn_features list (or clone_input)

assign

assignments (assign_cells())

segments

segments table

thr

allelic call threshold (NULL = from the control-region null)

par

data.table clone, c, a (attenuation; default a = 1)

members

data.table cell, clone used for orientation (default the assigned cells)

min_post

minimal posterior

min_event

minimal length of a non-neutral segment that makes a clone non-normal

q

null quantile

control

optional control regions (default control_regions() with min_len 5 Mb)

f_grid

major-haplotype fractions of the one-sided allelic score

null

"max" or "region" (see above)

Value

list(pool = cell names, table = per-cell event / control max score and flag, thr, normal = normal clones)
